## Description

What does this change do and why? Link any related issue.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / internal
- [ ] Docs only
- [ ] Dependency update

## Checklist

- [ ] Code builds: `go build ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...` clean
- [ ] Tests pass: `go test ./...` (CI also runs `-race`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change
- [ ] Public docs updated if behavior or config changed (`README.md`,
      `docs/guides/`)
- [ ] No secrets: no real tokens, `.env`, or `config.json` content

## Notes

Anything reviewers should know (upstream API quirks, verification on live
traffic, etc.)
